---
name: "nf-core/opt_flip_track_stat"
description: "Off-target probe detection"
keywords:
- "opt"
- "flip"
- "track"
- "stat"
- "off-target-probe-detection"
- "probes"
- "off-target probes"
components:
- "opt/flip"
- "opt/track"
- "opt/stat"
input:
- ch_probe_fasta:
    type: "file"
    description: "The input channel containing the probes used in spatial experiment\n\
      Structure: [ val(meta), path('probes.fasta') ]\n"
    pattern: "*.{fasta,fa}"
- ch_references:
    type: "file"
    description: "The input channel containing the reference fasta and reference gtf/gff\
      \ files\nStructure: [ val(meta), [\"reference_annotations.{gff/gtf}\"], [\"\
      reference_annotations.fa\"]]\n"
    pattern: "*{.gff,.gtf},*{.fa,.fasta}"
- ch_gene_synonyms:
    type: "file"
    description: "The input channel containing the gene synonyms file\nStructure:\
      \ [ path('gene_synonyms.csv') ]\n"
    pattern: "*.csv"
output:
- summary:
    type: "file"
    description: "Channel containing the collapsed summary of the off-target probes\n\
      Structure: [ val(meta), path(collapsed_summary.tsv) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.tsv"
authors:
- "@khersameesh24"
maintainers:
- "@khersameesh24"
version: "0.0.0-6d1763b"
license: "MIT License"
kind: "Workflow"
requires:
  modules:
  - "nf-core/opt/flip@0.0.0-6d1763b"
  - "nf-core/opt/track@0.0.0-6d1763b"
  - "nf-core/opt/stat@0.0.0-6d1763b"
